notes.title: Killer Bonus Update
notes.content:
A new update is Available now!

New Bonus Objectives for single player mode to gain a higher score!

Also Included in this update Is a Better Tutorial on the Training Map.

Much More Coming Soon!!

notes.title: Dreamer Update!
notes.content:
Many new features added to this update! New Guns and new attachments! 

Included in this update:

New Color Scheme to quickly identify weapon selections. 
Empty guns automatically switch. No more fumbling to find a gun with ammo.
Bosses now drop new guns.
Many other bug fixes as well.

Happy Killing!

notes.title: The Hunt
notes.content:
Get ready for a new mode on a new map called "The Hunt" This new map will feature a randomly generated Experience. 

Various Fixes as well included in this update.

notes.title: Guts and Gore!
notes.content: New update for more guts and gore! many new improvements to gameplay including more satisfying kills on your way to becoming a Dreamwalker!
